sentences.gloss: I am a student (a man speaking).
I am a student (a woman speaking).
You are a teacher (to a man).
You are a teacher (to a woman).
You are a friend (to a man).
You are a student (to a woman).
He is a man and she is a woman.
I am a pupil (a girl speaking).
I was a pupil (a woman speaking).

sentences.text: בֹּקֶר טוֹב, יוֹסִי! בֹּקֶר אוֹר, שָׂרָה!
sentences.gloss: Good morning, Yossi! — Good morning, Sarah!
Fine, thanks. How are you? (to a man)
Fine, thanks. How are you? (to a woman)
Excuse me, are you a teacher? (to a man)
Excuse me, are you a teacher? (to a woman)
Nice to meet you, I’m Yossi.

sentences.text: שָׁלוֹם, קוֹרְאִים לִי יוֹסִי. נָעִים מְאוֹד!
sentences.gloss: Hello, my name is Yossi. Nice to meet you!
Excuse me, are you students? (to a group)
Hi, how are you? (to a man)
Hi, how are you? (to a woman)
This is Yossi and this is Sarah.
Yossi is here and Sarah is there.
Are you here? — Yes, I’m here. (to a man)
The children are here and the teacher is there.

sentences.text: זֶה קִיר, זֶה חַלּוֹן וְזֹאת דֶּלֶת.
sentences.gloss: This is a wall, this is a window and this is a door.
This is a cup and this is a glass.
The pen and the paper are here.
The flat is here and the house is there.
